newsitem.title: CHINA: SOCCER-GUANGZHOU ENDS CHINA'S DALIAN WINNING STREA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-GUANGZHOU ENDS CHINA'S DALIAN WINNING STREA.

text.p: Guangzhou Apollo ended Dalian Wanda's winning streak but the defending champions retained their commanding lead in the standings after the seventh round of China's professional soccer league.

Dalian, who won in the first six rounds by outscoring their rivals 11-1, managed only a 1-1 draw when the team's Zhang Enhua scored in the 40th minute on Sunday, the Xinhua news agency said in an overnight report. Guangzhou had scored in the 30th minute.
Two-time champion Dalian now top the standings with 19 points, seven points clear of 1995 champions Shanghai Shenhua, who drew at home on Sunday against Tianjin Samsung 0-0.
Sichuan Quanxing moved one place up to third position after taking advantage of home-turf advantage to smash August First 4-0.
In the day's other games, Yanbian Aodong edged Vanguard Huandao 2-1 and Jinan Taishan beat Guangdong Hongyuan 2-0.
